title: Chapter 382: How Dare He Be
content:
Chapter 382: How Dare He Be

Lu Xue's tone was gentle, as if she was going to kill only three ants.

However, in Lu Xue's eyes, these three elders of the three gods were like ants at this moment.

Lu Xue's words not only made the three elders of the Three Gods stunned, but the rest of the human race in the hall also felt unresponsive.

The three of them were about to speak when a strong murderous intent came to their faces.

An Changzai and the other two did not even hesitate at all, and directly used the strongest killer move.

For a moment, the aura in the hall was turbulent.

The smile on the original face of the third elder of the God Clan was instantly replaced by fear. Without any nonsense, they immediately took action and took the killing moves of An Changzai and the other two.

boom!

A huge roar came from the hall.

Everyone looked closely and saw that the third elder of the God Clan looked ugly, his breath was weak, and a few strands of scarlet blood flowed from the corners of his mouth.

They stared at Lu Xue who was sitting calmly in the distance, and asked in a calm voice: "Do you know what you are doing?"

"If you kill us, the gods will never help you. That monster, whether it is your human race or our gods, only,

The elders of the God Clan have not finished speaking yet.

I saw that Lu Xue had raised her hand lightly.

That means, it is still killing without mercy.

At this time, the rest of the powerful people in the human race finally reacted.

This time, all the strong people of the human race walked up together, and the scene was instantly destroyed.

In the corner, the elders of the Holy Spirit Clan and the elders of the Heavenly Demon Clan silently looked at the scene in front of them, with a calm expression, but their hearts were in agitation.

When they saw the three gods' attitudes were so arrogant, they were all dissatisfied.

What they said is indeed correct.

Now that the enemy is in front of you, we should still share the same hatred of the enemy.

They never expected that this human leader would be so decisive and kill directly.

Could it be that the human race is not afraid of the monster destroying the entire Chaos Realm?

At the same time, the two of them also felt a little glimmer of gratitude.

Especially the elders of the Tian Yao Clan.

If the human race chose to go together at the beginning, then at this moment, there would be another corpse in the hall.

After a moment, with the last scream, it sounded.

The elder of the Tian Yao Clan widened his eyes, but the vitality in his body passed away quickly.

He died with his eyes open.

Facing all the strong men of the human race, and An Chang's three top combat powers, although the three elders of the God clan are very strong, they still have no power to resist.

"Lord of the Palace, fortunately, I will not be humiliated."

An Changzai arched towards Lu Xue.

Wu Shang stood there with a silent expression.

Huo Xingzhi wiped the blood from his face and chuckled, "It's better to kill on his own territory."

The human strong men around them all looked a little excited, and they hated the three gods to the core.

The three dead in front of us have a great status in the Three Gods.

All I can say is, it’s so cool!

"Cut off the heads of the three of them and hang them on the edge, so that all the creatures in the Chaos Realm can take a good look."

"The debts that owed to the human race will be paid back one by one."

"Yes! Lord of the Palace."

Then, Lu Xue looked at the two elders of the Holy Spirit Clan and the Heavenly Demon Clan in the corner.

The two of them were obviously slightly stunned, and then rushed forward.

"Lord Palace Master Lu."

Lu Xue nodded and then said, "That monster is extremely powerful and cannot be defeated by you and me."

Hearing this, the elder of the Holy Spirit Clan and the elder of the Heavenly Demon Clan frowned slightly, "What do you mean?"

Lu Xue closed her eyes slightly and said in a low voice: "Wait patiently."

.........

"Clan leader, this is what the Lord Lu said."

The elder of the Holy Spirit clan stood on the holy mountain and spoke respectfully at a ball of dazzling light.

"Be patient?"

A murmur came from the light ball, and then he fell into a long silence.

The elder of the Holy Spirit clan bowed his head slightly and stopped talking.

That's it, after a long time.

The light ball whispered, "Since that's the case, then that's all."

"Get out."

"Yes, patriarch."

.........

"His grandma, it's the same as if he didn't!"

"What a bullshit, just wait patiently, just say you can't do it."

Since the elder of the Tiandemon Clan returned to the territory of the demon clan, he has been cursing in his mouth.

And at this time, a little demon ran over happily.

"Sir, the patriarch wants to see you."

Hearing this, Baihu snorted lightly and said impatiently, "I know, I know."

Inside the valley.

Baihu stood in front of a small hill, lowered his head slightly, and said with a respectful tone, "Class leader, I'm back."

The sound kept echoing from the valley.

After a while, the hill gradually trembled, and a huge head with gravel slowly emerged from the cave.

The entire hill is actually a huge black turtle!

"Baihu, you're back."

"I've heard your complaints."

The black turtle spoke, his voice sounded like an old man in his twilight years.

Baihu sighed, "Clan leader, this human race doesn't look very reliable. That monster probably scares the human race."

"Since that's the case, it's up to us."

Hearing the words of the White Tiger, the Black Turtle smiled softly.

Seeing this, Baihu frowned and said, "Clan leader, are you laughing?"

The black turtle still spoke in a slight tone, "White Tiger, that human leader is extraordinary. Since she said that, she naturally has her reason."

"But what's the difference between this and waiting for death?"

Baihu still doesn't believe it.

Xuangui shook his head slightly, "I won't talk about this anymore. Do you still remember another thing I told you?"

Baihu nodded and said, "There are indeed some monsters in the human race, but they are not very strong. I don't feel the aura of the sky demon you mentioned."

“I can’t feel wrong.”

The black turtle sighed and slowly looked up at the sky, "The Heavenly Demon, it's really going to come to our clan again."

"Maybe, he is just a little weak in cultivation now, maybe he is hiding."

Baihu sat on the ground, and also looked up at the sky like the black turtle, "Can the demon that day deal with that monster?"

Xuan Turtle looked yearning, "If it is a growing demon, it will definitely be possible."

Hearing this, Baihu gave him a blank look and said angrily: "Then please wait patiently."

On the other hand, the atmosphere in the three gods was suppressed.

Now, in order to deal with the human race, the three gods are crowded in the small world of the gods.

They are closely together to maximize their strength.

But now, the three tribe leaders of the Three Gods' tribes looked as ugly as if they had eaten shit.

"How dare the other human race, how dare he, ah?!"

Bang!

The head of the Tianshen clan smashed the conference table in front of him with one punch.

On the side, the head of the Divine Power Clan raised his fist in the air and became a little embarrassed for a moment.

He twitched slightly, and then smashed the stool beside him with a punch.

With a plop.

The leader of the God Blood Clan sat on the ground because he had no stool.

His face turned pale and he simply sat directly on the ground.

How could a strong man like him make such a mistake? But this time, he didn't expect this action from the human race to kill him.
